confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus or booking listings. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is least certain given July seasonality. Cocktail and wine-glass anchors were set relative to beer (cocktail about 2.2x beer, wine about 1.1x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. Euro prices were converted at about 1.16 USD per EUR. The FX figure came from RBA search results, not a direct read of the live table, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked loosely against southern European capitals with similar tourist demand, such as Lisbon and Rome, then adjusted to Athens local price levels for cafes, tavernas, and central hotels during July peak season.
